questions.question: What is the difference between the number of students who play Tennis and those who play Polo?
questions.solution:
No. of students playing Tennis = 1080 × (108/360) = 324

No. of students playing Polo = 1080 × (36/360) = 108

∴ Difference = 324 - 108 = 216

questions.question: In which of the following group of sports, the sum of the number of students who play in the first 2 groups is equal to that of the third group?
questions.solution:
No. of students playing Tennis = 1080× (108/360) = 324

No. of students playing Polo = 1080× (36/360) = 108

No. of students playing Cricket = 1080× (72/360) = 216

No. of students playing Hockey = 1080× (90/360) = 270

No. of students playing Golf = 1080× (54/360) = 162

Checking each option one by one:

1: Cricket + Polo = 216 + 108 = 324 is not equal to hockey

2: Hockey + Tennis = 270 + 324 = 594 is not equal to Golf

3: Cricket + Polo = 216 + 108 = 324 = Tennis

4: Hockey + Cricket = 270 + 216 = 486 is not equal to Tennis

∴ Option 3 is correct.

questions.question:
The pie chart given below shows the production of wheat by six states. The total production of wheat by all these six states is 3600. The production of wheat of a particular state is shown in terms of degree with respect to the total production of wheat by all these six states.

What is the difference between average production of wheat by P and Q and the average production of wheat by R and T?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96d890a51ef1c5f6aa4c6829a759cd15640b05655d08267e13dbc4bbe868db18.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total production of wheat by 6 states = 360° = 3600

⇒ 1° = 10

Production of state P = 110° = 110 × 10 = 1100

Production of state Q = 70° = 70 × 10 = 700

Average production by state P & Q = (1100 + 700)/2 = 900

Production of state R = 80° = 80 × 10 = 800

Production of state T = 20° = 20 × 10 = 200

Average production by state R & T = (800 + 200)/2 = 500

Difference between the average production of P and Q and R & T = 900 - 500 = 400

**∴ The correct answer is 400.**

questions.question:
The pie-chart shows the distribution of the 5,00,040 employed people of a city according to their occupations in terms of the central angles of the sectors representing people engaged in the different occupations mentioned.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/716af5d5f202c30cc90b9f051cfe5e25720835ce72bcbaefcbdb7bd34cfd9ef2.png] 

As per the information provided above, how many more people work in the service sector when compared to the number of people who engage themselves in business?
questions.solution:
Given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/716af5d5f202c30cc90b9f051cfe5e25720835ce72bcbaefcbdb7bd34cfd9ef2.png] 

Total number of employees = 5,00,040

Calculation:

Total share for all sectors = 36 + 24 + 108 + 42 + 150 = 360

Degree for service sector = 42

Number of people working in the service sector = (42)/(360)times 500040 = 58,338

Degree for business sector = 24

Number of people working in the business sector = (24)/(360)times 500040 = 33,336

Difference in the number of people in both of these sectors = 58,338 – 33,336 = 25,002

Hence, there are 25,002 more people working in the service sector compared to the business sector.

questions.solution:

The total angle at the centre of a pie chart = 360o

If the ratio of male employees to female employees in department A is 3 : 4, then the number of employees in department C is what percentage more than the number of female employees in department A (nearest to an integer)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total employees in C = 4500 × 81.2/360 = 1015

Total employees in A = 4500 × 98/360 = 1225

Now, total female employees in A = 1225 × 4/7 = 700

Difference = 1015 - 700 = 315

% = 315/700 × 100 = 45%

**∴ Required percentage is 45**

The number of students studying in schools J, L and M together = (29 + 5 + 25)% = 59%
